description: A43: an accepted ack for log.set_value, log.increment or log.delete carries xp_delta (+10 or -10) when that mutation moved XP, and no xp_delta key otherwise. It is stored in the receipt, so a duplicate replay returns the same ack. Each case creates a quantity habit (target 2000.000) and runs its steps in order on one habit-day; a step with replay_of re-sends an earlier step's mutation. Old apps ignore the key (A21).

cases.name: an undo below the target takes 10 back
a partial write carries no key
deleting a completed day takes 10 back
a duplicate replay returns the same xp_delta

rules: xp_delta null in a step means the ack has no xp_delta key at all
the amount comes from the server's rules (A40); the app never infers it from totals
